intro: Fan Crown uses native rewards on Twitch and Kick, plus Viewer Foundation points on YouTube and TikTok. Twitch keeps full reward mutation and refund support.

sections.title: 1. Connect each platform
sections.description: Paste Twitch and Kick reward IDs, then create the no-response Fan Crown command for YouTube and TikTok.
sections.notice: Recommended rewards — Twitch: Fan Crown, base cost from this page, gold #F2C94C, description 'Claim the crown and become the stream current No. 1 Fan', Skip Reward Queue off. Kick: use the same title, description, color, and a fixed cost equal to Base cost. Kick captures are native, but Streamer.bot cannot automatically change the Kick title/cost or refund a rejected claim. YouTube and TikTok spend the current displayed cost from Viewer Foundation.

sections.title: 2. Price progression
sections.description: Fixed increase is predictable. Multiplier is an advanced option. Every mode is rounded and stopped at the hard maximum.

sections.title: 3. Viewer rules and resets
sections.description: The current holder is blocked by default. Optional cooldowns use platform-qualified stable user IDs rather than changeable display names.

sections.title: 4. Platform chat messages
sections.description: Capture announcements are editable. Refund explanations are disabled by default to avoid chat noise.

sections.title: 5. Crown overlay
sections.description: Use the add-on overlay URL shown by the wizard. Long names and leaderboard text are safely bounded by the hosted card.

sections.title: Maintenance and privacy
sections.description: The companion package includes Reset Crown and Reset Month actions. Attach them only to creator-controlled hotkeys or deck buttons.
sections.notice: Fan Crown stores only platform-qualified stable user IDs, current display names, optional HTTPS avatars, aggregate points, capture counts, and bounded timestamps in private atomic state. It stores no chat text, OAuth token, SlothCoin balance, or hard-coded file path. Trigger tests and simulated reward events never mutate the real reward.
